slots.label: Corner boards (four)
slots.unfit: The corner art curves over 37x21 px; the rink's corners curve over 112 px (28 ft), which is 112x83 on screen. Shown only in the corner fit test arena.

slots.label: Kickplates (separate layers)
slots.note: Same pixels as the kickplates inside the board modules; registered, not drawn separately.
